models_evaluated: AURA (commercial LLM with retrieval-augmented generation over 6546 aesthetic surgery publications)

links.outcome: Faithfulness of RAG-grounded outputs to source literature across 14 scenarios
links.effect: Mean faithfulness 0.94, answer relevancy 0.86, factual correctness 0.77; performance stronger for established techniques and safety than emerging procedures.
links.quote: AURA demonstrated exceptional performance with mean scores of 0.94 for faithfulness, 0.86 for answer relevancy, and 0.77 for factual correctness.

screen.reason: The study describes the development and offline evaluation of a RAG-based LLM system (AURA) across 14 clinical scenarios in aesthetic surgery, measuring faithfulness and relevancy, without evaluating a specific operational deployment practice or safeguard comparison.
